terms.definition: A tiny particle carrying a negative charge that orbits the nucleus.
terms.function: The particle that does the chemistry — shared, lost, or gained in reactions.
terms.whereItIs: The small teal dots orbiting the nucleus in the cloud.
terms.whyItMatters: Electrons are responsible for every chemical reaction and bond.

terms.definition: The large region around the nucleus where electrons orbit.
terms.function: Holds the electrons in organized shell layers around the atom.
terms.whereItIs: The large translucent sphere in the model.
terms.whyItMatters: The cloud is where all chemistry happens.

terms.definition: An electron in the outermost shell of an atom.
terms.function: The electron that bonds — it is shared, lost, or gained during reactions.
terms.whereItIs: The outer-shell electron reaching toward the partner atom.
terms.whyItMatters: Valence electrons decide how an atom reacts.

terms.definition: An atom that has gained or lost electrons, giving it a charge.
terms.function: Forms when electrons are transferred during reactions.
terms.whereItIs: The result of the electron leaving in the bonding layer.
terms.whyItMatters: Ions are how atoms become charged and react.
